chapter: Emmett Hardy, Bix and the Rhythm Kings
title: Hardy leaves with Blossom Seeley's act and joins Carlisle Evans in Davenport
summary: Hazel tells how Hardy and Rappolo toured vaudeville, broke up in Rockford, and joined Carlisle Evans where Bix first heard Hardy.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows
